task_instance: Created a small representative static HTML/CSS page (sample-page.html: a contact form with a header, autoplay video banner, div-based nav/buttons, an icon-only button, unlabeled form fields, and a modal) and ran a WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility audit on it by reading the markup/CSS and manually computing color-contrast ratios (WCAG relative-luminance formula) by hand, producing the full audit report in the skill's exact output format (summary counts, findings tables by POUR category, color contrast table, keyboard navigation table, screen reader table, and priority fixes) in accessibility-audit.md.
evidence:
Files produced in the work directory: sample-page.html (the sample design/page under audit) and accessibility-audit.md (the deliverable). The audit was verified by: (1) re-deriving each of the 5 contrast ratios from the raw hex values in sample-page.html using the WCAG relative-luminance formula (e.g. #999999 on #ffffff = 2.85:1, #6fa8ff on #2d6cdf = 2.02:1, white on #eeeeee button = 1.16:1, #4d90fe link on white = 3.12:1, #cc0000 on white = 5.89:1 -- pass), all cross-checked against the 4.5:1/3:1 AA thresholds; (2) manually tracing the markup for every interactive control (three
nav items, an icon
